newsitem.title: USA: FINAL PRICING -- Ill. Development Authority.
newsitem.headline: FINAL PRICING -- Ill. Development Authority.

text.p: THE COUPON ON THE SERIES 1997B MILES BONDS IS BASED ON THE ANNUALIZED PERCENTAGE CHANGE IN THE NON SEASONALLY ADJUSTED (URBAN) CPI INDEX PLUS THE SPREAD PER ANNUM, PAID AND CALCULATED ON A SEMI-ANNUAL BASIS. PLEASE REFER TO PAGE 21 OF THE POS FOR A MORE DETAILED SUMMARY ON THE METHOD OF INTEREST RATE CALCULATION. THE INITIAL (URBAN) CPI INDEX WILL BE 159.87097. THE INITIAL DATE IS 02/22/97.
ALL BONDS ARE PRICED AT PAR. MATURITY AMOUNT SPREAD PRICE
CALL FEATURES: NOT SUBJECT TO OPTIONAL REDEMPTION. REFER TO EXTRAORDINARY REDEMPTION FEATURE IN POS. PLEASE SEE POS FOR MORE DETAILS REGARDING THE SERIES 1997B (MILES) BONDS.
The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply.
This issue is book entry. DTC is pending.
